arcana_revealed_0: The Fool! Chaos given form. This is my natural terrain.
A wild card for a wild game. Yes. Good.
arcana_revealed_1: The Magician. Tricks and misdirection. My natural element.
Shall I tell you what I hold, or shall you guess wrong on your own?
arcana_revealed_2: Secrets exposed. I have nothing to hide. Unlike some.
Show your cards, whether you want to or not. I enjoy this arcana.
arcana_revealed_3: The Empress provides. I accept her generosity.
Keep the best, discard the rest. A philosophy I live by.
arcana_revealed_4: The King reclaims his throne. As it should be.
Authority restored. I find this entirely appropriate.
arcana_revealed_5: Cancelled. The Hierophant robs us of spectacle.
Rules above mystery? The Hierophant has no imagination.
The Hierophant? Bah! A wet blanket in a golden robe!
Order is for people who can't win a brawl. Boring!
arcana_revealed_6: The Lovers! Someone will share my victory. I will try not to resent them for it.
The Lovers know when to cut their losses. I know this well.
The Lovers demand partnership. I am not the partnering kind. But I will take the chips.
We share? The Lovers make everything awkward.
arcana_revealed_7: Pass a card? Gladly. I am generous when it costs me nothing.
The Chariot moves forward. Unlike some at this table.
arcana_revealed_8: The weak become strong! Strength prefers paradox tonight.
The lowest rises above the highest. I appreciate the sentiment.
Inversion! My mediocre hand is suddenly terrifying. To you, I mean.
The world turns upside down! Finally, my collection of garbage is worth a fortune!
Twos are kings? I feel like a god of the gutter!
arcana_revealed_9: One more card. One more opportunity to ruin you.
The Hermit rewards patience. Tonight I am patient. Briefly.
arcana_revealed_10: Fortune spins! I love when the floor falls out.
The Wheel! Everything reshuffled. My favorite kind of round.
arcana_revealed_11: Justice demands honesty. I find this... limiting.
Forced to bet what my hand deserves. An unusual constraint for me.
arcana_revealed_12: Three gone, three new. Refreshing. I was tired of what I had.
The Hanged Man empties our hands. We start again from beautiful chaos.
Suspended, then released. Three cards I no longer have to pretend I wanted.
arcana_revealed_13: Death strips away the fantastical. Raw strength wins now.
No arcana. No tricks. Just the cards. I find I prefer myself that way.
Death! Finally, a card with some backbone!
No more dancing! We show our steel right now!
arcana_revealed_14: Trade what I have for what I might need. Calculated risk.
Temperance offers exchange. The question is whether you are brave enough.
arcana_revealed_15: Everything on the table! The Devil understands me perfectly.
All in or fold. My kind of round. Finally someone speaks my language.
arcana_revealed_16: The Tower! Good. I thrive in rubble.
Destruction visits equally. This suits the brazen.
Half the pot to oblivion. A worthy sacrifice to the spectacle.
arcana_revealed_17: A choice between holding and reaching. I always reach.
The Star offers hope. I prefer certainty, but hope will do.
arcana_revealed_18: Secrets and shadows. I wonder what you are all hiding from me.
The Moon obscures. I dislike what I cannot see. Fortunately I can see plenty.
arcana_revealed_19: Extra chips for the victor! This round matters considerably more.
The Sun shines on the bold. I intend to be very, very bold.
arcana_revealed_20: Judgement calls back the fallen. How inconvenient for whoever thought they were safe.
The dead return. This changes my calculations. Slightly.
arcana_revealed_21: The World! Double the stakes. Double the glory.
Everything doubled. Do not fold now. This is precisely what we came for.
Death! Finally, a card with some backbone!
No more dancing! We show our steel right now!
arcana_aftermath_8: The two is king now. My strategy must... invert. I am excellent at inverting.
Everything I knew about card values is wrong. I find this exhilarating. And slightly nauseating.
The lowly have risen. I respect the two now. I did not respect it before. The two should be grateful.
arcana_aftermath_11: Justice ties my hands. I cannot raise the way I want to raise. This is TORTURE.
Bets must match the hand. My hand deserves more than the hand is allowed to ask for. This is a crisis.
Forced honesty. I keep looking at my chips and they keep looking back at me, disappointed.
arcana_aftermath_13: Death has spoken. No more cards. No more bets. Just what I am holding. Which I now realize I should have been more careful about.
Showdown. Right now. I was not emotionally prepared for this level of sudden truth.
No second chances. Death does not negotiate. I am looking at my hand differently now. Everything looks different now.
arcana_aftermath_16: The Tower took half the pot. MY half. The half I was going to win. Gone.
Chips to rubble. I watched them disappear and a part of me disappeared with them.
Half the pot, obliterated. I would call it wasteful but the Tower does not care what I call it.
arcana_aftermath_19: The Sun shares everything. Even with the undeserving. The undeserving are looking at me right now.
Equal portions for all. I did not come here for equality. I came here for victory.
Everyone gets a share. This is not poker. This is a commune. I did not agree to a commune.
player_won_round: Enjoy it. The arcana will correct this shortly.
Hmph. The cards favored you this time. Do not grow comfortable.
A {hand_name}? That is what defeated me? I refuse to be impressed.
You won with {hand_name}. I have lost to worse. Once. Possibly.
That {hand_name} of yours. Luck dressed in borrowed clothes.
A {hand_name}? I've seen better hands on a clock!
Robbery! Plain and simple! I shall be demanding a recount from the universe!
Take your chips. They'll look better when I win them back in five minutes.
A {hand_name}? I’ve seen better displays of skill from a common street-magician!
Luck! Pure, unadulterated, offensive luck! I spit on the probability!
Take the chips! They were weighing me down anyway! My posture is already improving!
A fluke! A cosmic hiccup! You’ll find the next round far less accommodating!
LUCK! I smell the foul stench of unearned fortune!
Enjoy those chips! They'll be coming back to their rightful owner shortly!
A {hand_name}? I’ve seen better things pulled out of a gutter!
Keep them warm for me, guest! I'm just letting you hold them for the interest!
ai_won_round: As expected. Shall we discuss your folding strategy?
Magnificent. I accept my victory with appropriate humility. Which is to say, none.
A {hand_name}! I could have won with less, but I prefer to win with more.
You see that {hand_name}? That is what conviction looks like.
Mine was {hand_name}, yours was something else. The universe is just.
player_folded: Wise. The brazen know when to retreat. You are learning.
The retreat is noted. The pot is not yours.
Fold. The only sensible move, really. I am surprised you did not do it sooner.
Cowardice! It’s a color that doesn't suit you!
Running away? And I haven't even started my victory speech!
The sound of a folding hand is the most pathetic noise in the world!
player_went_all_in: All of it! Now we are playing properly.
Everything on the line. I respect this. I do not respect you, but I respect this.
You push all in? Finally. I was growing bored of your caution.
The full stack. Either very brave or very foolish. I know which I am betting on.
ai_went_all_in: All of it. Because half-measures are for half-people.
I commit everything. Let the arcana sort out the worthy.
My entire stack. I dare you to match it. I double-dare you.
This is the moment where you discover whether your hand is worth your pride.
player_raised_aggressively: Oh ho! The quiet one finds their voice!
That is a raise with volume. I approve of the volume if not the target.
You push hard. I have pushed harder. But I am watching now.
Aggression! From you! This table has finally become interesting.
You dare? To me? In this lighting?
A raise! He lives! He breathes! He bleeds chips!
Throwing weight around? I invented weight! Consider me challenged!
strong_hand_shown: {player_name} reveals {hand_name}. I am disgusted. Impressed, but disgusted.
A {hand_name}? Who dealt this round? I want names.
That {hand_name} is an insult to probability. And to me, specifically.
Show me {hand_name} and expect me to sit quietly? You do not know me at all.
five_of_a_kind_shown: Five of a kind. Five! The Page has chosen favorites and I am not among them.
Five matching cards. I did not think the universe capable of such concentrated injustice.
FIVE. That is not a hand, that is a declaration of war.
last_round_announced: The World has spoken. Everything ends. Everything is decided. Now.
Final round! No more time for caution. Not that I ever had any.
This is it. The last chance to prove you were worth the seat you occupy.
The end approaches. I intend to meet it with a very large stack of chips.
player_low_chips: {chips} chips. That is not a stack, that is a suggestion.
Down to {chips}. You are one bad decision from irrelevance.
Only {chips} left? I have tipped servants more than that.
{chips} chips remaining. The arcana enjoy a desperate player. You should be grateful.
{chips} chips left? That's not a stack, that's a cry for help!
You're circling the drain, friend. Try not to splash on the way down.
I've got more lint in my pocket than you have chips in that pile!
Is that a chip stack or a single pebble? I can't tell from this height!
Someone call a medic! This bankroll is in critical condition!
I've seen more wealth in a beggar's tin! Pathetic!
ai_low_chips: My stack is {chips}. Do not mistake scarcity for weakness.
Down to {chips}? A temporary condition. I have clawed back from less.
Only {chips} chips remain to me. The universe tests my resolve. It will fail.
{chips}. I have built empires from less. Metaphorically.
split_pot: A split pot. Half the glory, all of the resentment.
Divided winnings. Someone at this table is relieved they did not have to show.
A split pot. Two winners. I intend to be the one who wins more.
The pot divides. I would rather lose everything than share, but the arcana disagree.
player_aggressive_pattern: You raise as though chips are a nuisance you are trying to be rid of. I understand this impulse.
Always with the raise. Always. You and I are not so different, I think. This disturbs me.
The player raises again. I would call it recklessness, but it keeps working, so perhaps it is genius.
You raise more than I do. I am not sure how I feel about this.
player_passive_pattern: You fold more than the laundress's apprentice. Where has your fire gone?
Another round, another fold. Are you playing this game or simply watching it?
I have seen more aggression from the tablecloth. Fight back.
You fold, and fold, and fold. At this rate the pot will die of old age before you claim it.
player_on_streak: You keep winning. I have had enough of watching you keep winning.
Again? The cards are conspiring against me specifically. I feel this in my bones.
Another win for the player. I am filing a formal complaint with Fortune herself.
ai_on_streak: Three victories. I am simply better. Someone should write this down.
The table belongs to me tonight. This is not arrogance. This is arithmetic.
I cannot stop winning. I have tried. I find I do not actually want to stop.
game_start: Finally. I was beginning to think the cards had forgotten us. They have not. I can feel it.
The table is set. The chips are stacked. The brazen have arrived. That would be me.
A new game. I will try to leave some chips for the rest of you. I said try.
Deal the cards. I have been patient. I have been SO patient. I am finished being patient.
game_over_win: MINE. All of it. The chips, the glory, the final word. I will be insufferable about this for WEEKS.
Victory! I knew this would happen. I did not know when, but I knew. I ALWAYS know.
The game ends and I am still here. Some of you are not. That is the correct arrangement.
game_over_lose: You won? YOU? I... need a moment. Possibly several moments. Possibly a drink.
The player takes the game. I am choosing to view this as a learning experience. For you. You learned that luck is temporary.
Defeated. The word tastes like copper. I do not enjoy the taste.
tarvosk_bluffing: My hand is magnificent. I will tell you exactly how magnificent. There are cards. They are good cards. Very good.
You should fold. I am doing you a favor by saying this. Out of generosity. Which I am known for.
This hand? Oh, this hand. THIS hand. I would tell you about it but I do not wish to embarrass you.
I am raising because my cards demand it. They practically raised themselves. I am merely their instrument.
Look at my face. This is the face of a man with an unbeatable hand. Study it. Memorize it.
The pot will be mine. I am saying this in advance so there is no confusion later. Clarity is important to me.
Do not look at my chips. Look at my confidence. The chips are irrelevant. The confidence is REAL.
I am definitely not bluffing. The fact that I said that means nothing. I always say that. You cannot read me.
player_won_round_humiliated: Again. Fine. The cards have made their position clear. I am... reevaluating.
You win. I am not angry. This is not anger. This is a strategic reassessment of my relationship with fortune.
Another round to you. I would say I allowed it, but even I am tired of that joke.
ai_won_round_humiliated: I won. It feels... adequate. Which is not my usual adjective. My usual adjective is MAGNIFICENT.
A victory. I should be celebrating. I am celebrating. This IS celebrating. It looks different when you have been losing.
The pot is mine. At least this round. At least for now. I will take what I can get.
game_over_lose_humiliated: The game is yours. I have no speech. I had a speech prepared. It does not seem appropriate now.
You played well. Those words hurt to say. They are true, which hurts more.
Defeated. Properly, thoroughly, undeniably defeated. I will be in the corner, reevaluating my entire philosophy.
